premise: a survival and extraction game of scavenged stashes, crafting and radiation

slots.name: wasteland/panel
slots.note: A large post-apocalyptic interface panel: one rectangular sheet of rusted steel plate, completely opaque and solid everywhere including its centre (no hole, no transparency). Its whole face one even weathered gunmetal-brown plate (#2b221a), the same tone from its edge to its centre, with fine scratches and faint grime spread evenly over it: no inner rectangle, no darker or lighter centre, no inset, no vignette. Rust bloom gathers along its border, a raised 3 px lip of corroded orange-brown (#7a4a2a) rust runs all round, and one round rivet head sits in each corner. Square corners with a tiny 2 px chip; no duct tape, no stencilled words, no hazard stripes. As the large frames of the concept's settings and stash. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: wasteland/card
slots.note: A crafting card or stash tile, repeated many times side by side: a small sheet of dark scratched steel (#23201c), a thin 1.5 px worn rust-brown edge (#5a3d28), one tiny rivet in each corner. Plain and opaque inside, no orange, no tape, no text. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: wasteland/field
slots.note: A plain input box: a recessed dark steel slot (#171512) with a 1 px worn grey-brown (#4a443c) edge and a faint inner shadow along its top. Square corners. Nothing else: no rivets, no rust blooms, no marks. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: wasteland/slot
slots.note: An inventory slot repeated many times in a grid: a sunken square of dark scuffed steel (#1c1a17) with a 1.5 px darker rim (#0e0d0b) and a thin lighter scratched bevel (#4a4339) along its bottom and right. Square corners, plain, no rivets, no orange, no tape. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: wasteland/tooltip
slots.note: A small tooltip: a fully opaque dark steel tag (#1b1916) with a 1.5 px worn rust edge (#6b4428) and a short strip of grey duct tape across its top-left corner. Square corners; plain inside. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: wasteland/hud
slots.note: A HUD readout plate laid over a game scene: a small opaque rectangle of dark riveted steel (#211e1a) with a 2 px worn rust-brown edge (#5c3b24) and one small rivet in each corner, its centre plain. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: wasteland/button
slots.note: A secondary button: a raised slab of dark weathered steel (#34302a) with a 2 px rust-brown bevelled edge (#6a4428), lighter scratched top edge and a darker bottom edge, small worn chips at its corners; the label area plain so light text reads on it. Hovered: one step lighter. Square corners with a 2 px chip; no rivets, no tape, no stripes. As the inactive tabs and keys of the concept. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: wasteland/button-primary
slots.note: The primary button: a slab of bright safety-orange painted steel filling the whole piece, its face a clean, light, even safety orange (#ffaa50) so near-black text reads on it at a glance: no dark chips, scratches, rust or rivets anywhere on the face, no darker band, no shading towards the edges. Wear only at the very corners (a few small chips through to dark metal) and a thin 2 px darker orange edge (#c86a20) all round. Square corners; no tape, no gear, no text. As the CRAFT button and the selected STASH tab of the concept. Its top, bottom, left and right edges are plain and even along their whole length (they stretch): any detail sits in the four corners, none at the middle of an edge.

slots.name: wasteland/corner
slots.note: A short strip of grey silver duct tape stuck diagonally across a corner: one torn strip about 30 px long and 10 px wide, at 45°, its torn ends ragged, a little crumpled and shiny, on a clear background. As the tape on the concept's panels. Nothing else.

slots.name: wasteland/divider
slots.note: A horizontal divider: one 2 px line of worn dark steel (#4a443c) with a 1 px darker shadow under it, even weight from end to end, a few faint scratches; on a clear background. No ornament at the middle.

slots.name: wasteland/flourish
slots.note: A heading accent: three short slanted hazard stripes, safety orange (#f5821f) and near-black, like a stencilled warning mark, about 24 px wide in a 64 px image, on a clear background. Nothing else.

slots.name: wasteland/thumb
slots.note: A slider's thumb: one narrow upright safety-orange (#f5821f) painted steel block centred in a square image, as tall as the image and about a third as wide (8 of 24), worn chips at its corners and a 1 px dark edge. Fully transparent to its left and right. As the orange handles on the concept's sliders. Nothing else: no track.

slots.name: wasteland/knob
slots.note: Only the sliding knob of a toggle switch, not the switch: one small square of brushed steel (#c8c2b6) with a dark grip groove down its middle and a 1 px dark edge, as the knob of the concept's ON toggle. Fully transparent around it.

slots.name: wasteland/knob-off
slots.note: Only the sliding knob of a toggle switch, not the switch: one small square of dull dark steel (#6a655d) with a dark grip groove down its middle and a 1 px darker edge, as the knob of the concept's OFF toggle. Fully transparent around it.
